raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The vLLM attention replacement does not include model specific softmax scales which makes GPT-OSS and DeepSeek lose their YaRN-adjusted scaling.

I just exposed the scale as a property on the attention config and threaded it through to vLLM. Not sure if this is how you’d want it done.

KL mismatch went from 0.055 before to 0.0006 with GPT-OSS-20b. I didn't test deepseek.

thanks for the pr @haydn-jones! We will review it. 

If you are using GPT-OSS, there a few things you have to be aware:

1. freeze bias/router: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5271
2. For perf, take a look at this stack: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5192
3. Ask your agent to sanity check if the attn kernels you are using for your hardware are fast. There may be a large difference between cudnn, flag attn, flash-infer for fwd+bwd/prefill/decode

Sorry that those are not merged yet. We have been mostly focused on qwen 35B MoE. This model is more optimized and tested if you are interested.

Feel free to shoot an email if you want to chat at some point and share more about the work you are doing / features you are looking for felipemello@meta.com

detail.body:
The vLLM attention replacement does not include model specific softmax scales which makes GPT-OSS and DeepSeek lose their YaRN-adjusted scaling.

I just exposed the scale as a property on the attention config and threaded it through to vLLM. Not sure if this is how you’d want it done.

KL mismatch went from 0.055 before to 0.0006 with GPT-OSS-20b. I didn't test deepseek.

+import importlib
+
 import pytest
 import torch
 import torch.distributed as dist
@@ -24,6 +26,35 @@
 )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model_name, expected_scale",
+    [
+        ("gpt_oss", 0.22665755425493697),
+        ("deepseek_v3", 0.11425195291833387),
+        ("qwen3", None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_vllm_replacement_preserves_attention_scale(model_name, expected_scale):
+    """Preserve YaRN scaling as well as the backend's default scale."""
+    model_config = importlib.import_module(
+        f"torchtitan.models.{model_name}"
+    ).build_model_config("debugmodel", seq_len=128, parallelism=ParallelismConfig())
+    vllm_config = _replace_vllm_layer_configs(model_config)
+
+    for model_layer, vllm_layer in zip(
+        model_config.layers, vllm_config.layers, strict=True
+    ):
+        attention_config = model_layer.attention
+        scale = vllm_layer.attention.inner_attention.scale
+        if expected_scale is None:
+            assert scale is None
+        else:
+            assert scale == pytest.approx(expected_scale)
+            with torch.device("meta"):
+                attention = attention_config.build()
+            assert scale == attention.softmax_scale
+
+

+        @property

+            scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
